# M2-A hunter reconciliation — implementation handoff

Source **35c2d22473ff17ed907c62362c25d17ed47cbcd0** implements ROOT-HUNTER-01/02/03 from the clean exact parent **150e334fe1a98d1adb23f0065cb167a597d1e35e**. The final full check passes **536/536**, typecheck and production build; all three economy checkers pass, including fresh and completed-earned M2 input. Each required scenario meets the root's **≤2 ms warm p95** trial in three independent runs. Nearby parked/disabled hulls now obstruct the hunter and its mouth LOS after exit. This is an author handoff for root inspection and fresh non-author Astra xhigh/Sol6.1 max review, without an M2-A acceptance claim.

All new artifacts are in `/tmp/siltwake-m2-a-hunter-reconcile/`. **ROOT-HUNTER-02 — exact queries and bounded immutable data.** Profiling preceded optimization: `raw/CPU.20261019.042331.2606956.0.001.cpuprofile`, `raw/baseline-profile-summary.json` and `logs/baseline-profile.log` identify repeated `triangleBox` work as the leading cost (3,670 self samples), followed by transform/triangle work. The new numeric seam precomputes immutable authored local triangles, component/triangle/mesh bounds, exact normalized support axes and vertices. Closest-point rejection retains strict triangle order/ties; inside rejection and SAT retain exact narrow-phase tests. Per-evaluation actor transforms, skin and lazy world triangles are reused. No mutable GameState, contact, world pose, berth result or visibility snapshot survives an evaluation.

Existing hunter exports remain compatible. The two new readonly diagnostics are `hunterFleetObstruction(state, position?) -> {gap, penetrating, hullId}` and bounded `hunterFleetSweep(state, start, end, from, to) -> boolean`; invalid or excessive sweep requests refuse. They neither mutate fleet state nor select a damage target. `hunterQueries.ts` owns the pure geometry operations and bounded immutable mesh caches.

**ROOT-HUNTER-03 — nearby fleet authority and conservative movement.** Every non-controlled hull remains an obstacle regardless of disabled health. Independent Dart pitch is respected; berthed craft use the carrier-local berth transform rather than stale independent poses. Relevant carrier structural shell/hatch state comes from existing `carrierStructure`, including sealed panes and the transaction's open slot. Carried/berthed presentation is not replaced by a second stale hull. Actual hull primitives and shell faces remain the narrow-phase authority, leaving real carrier gaps open. Mouth→controlled-target LOS tests other opaque hull surfaces; parked hulls never silently become damage targets.

Fleet translation uses the hunter's unchanged full-animation world envelope (radius4.65, bottom−1.23, top2.91) continuously swept against actual hull triangles with time-interval SAT. This conservative animal envelope contains every derived yaw/roll, so changing target orientation cannot rotate its unsaved pose into a parked hull between steps. It can refuse more space than the current rendered animal occupies; this is a deliberate hunter-only clearance tradeoff. It does not turn a carrier's coarse broad-phase square into a wall or change ordinary vessel/player physics.

For retained overlap, a supporting-plane certificate for each initial hull prevents closing along its selected escape plane over the accepted linear path. Finite ordered directions may separate or skirt; refusal is safe. Conservative-envelope-only overlap uses normal movement rates. **13m/s applies only to actual penetration**, while normal pursuit/investigate remain7/3m/s. No decode relocation, teleport, player/vessel displacement or penetration bite is used. New clear-space movement/turn tests sample the whole rendered-pose transition in addition to the continuous production sweep; the retained source also preserves static/terrain sweep checks.

The six new tests cover disabled parked solidity after exit, a turn with clear endpoints but an obstructed midpoint, two nearby hulls while the controlled actor moves/turns, real12825 overlap escape, berth/shell/open-gap authority, and parked-pane LOS/current target identity. The parked regression run against the old implementation fails at **swept sample6** (`logs/parked-regression-red.log`); it passes on the candidate. `logs/hunter-tests.log` records17 focused passes: ten original encounter cases, six new cases and the support-extrema case. The existing actor-overlap, default movement, rib/terrain/boundary and interruption/recovery checks also pass in the full suite.
